title: Mcp Design Viewer Uses Flatten For Scene Split
description: McpDesignViewer showed diagram-only because ComposeDesign requires hasPlanes (pieces with plane+center). MCP payloads often ship raw kit designs without per-piece planes. Fix: apply flattenDesign(kit, guid) + applyDesignDiff like Storybook Design story, for design and scene surfaces. Export mcpEffectiveSurface for tests; add vitest describe for surface resolution.
summary: Fix diagram-only MCP design viewer by making flattenDesign preserve computed root piece plane/center in pieceMap (previously overwritten when flatDesign.pieces was remapped from pieceMap). Added `mcpFlattenDesignForComposeSurface` helper that augments `kit.designs` when MCP kit shells omit the referenced design. Viewer uses helper for design/scene surfaces so ComposeDesign's `hasPlanes` becomes true and the scene column renders. Added vitest coverage asserting flatten enables plane+center when kit omits design entry. Verified: `cd compose/ui && npm test` passed.
